rules.description: CairnJS core runtime MUST remain strictly zero-dependency with no external npm runtime dependencies.
Reactivity must update targeted DOM nodes directly via fine-grained signal subscriptions without whole-tree Virtual DOM diffing.
All developer errors and warnings must follow the 3-part diagnostic structure: 1. Context/Summary, 2. Location/Cause, 3. Actionable Code Fix.
Identical component inputs and state primitives must produce deterministic, identical DOM node structures across runs.
Keep CPU reflows and memory allocations minimal; utilize CSS keyframes, Canvas 2D, or WebGL/WebGPU for heavy kinetic motion.
